title: Prove a fixed-source fractional price gap in the original full-contact relaxation
body:
The original PR5016 continuous marginal/rank-selector relaxation admits fractional “ghost ranks” even when every source frame variable is fixed to its actual integral value. On edge `(9288,11432,I_9)`, replace rank one by `y0=y2=1/2`: all original constraints hold, but its price becomes `2^(t-1)<1` for every `0<t<1`.

This adds a source-bound certificate for **both actual orientations**, executing the unchanged original model-building AST through all mathematical constraints and bounds, without a solver. An independent set/XOR checker reconstructs the complete row multiset and verifies interval-domain completeness. The rational witness passes all 9,432 rows and 9,276 bounds (41,952 coefficients) per orientation. The stored floating objective bits also yield a strictly positive exact rational discount; the all-price statement is proved analytically.

The result is a strict gap on the **fixed-source-marginal face** and a relaxed objective better than the source. The global integer optimum remains unknown, so this is not a global integrality-gap theorem or a native optimality certificate. The original binary MIP is not defective; a genuine pair-consistent LP rejects the witness. This narrows the initial full-contact/local-pair investigation to the precise original-source obstruction it establishes. No new native word, kappa or selected frontier is claimed.

Validation: registered Python 3.12.2 replay and optimized replay pass; independent peer proof/code review and a separate Fraction check pass; all-row/domain checks reject wrong mass, wrong mean, negative selectors and an omitted row. Official 22-file committed export/source-history checks pass. The exported package passes in a read-only Git-free tree with unchanged bytes; actual source drift and receipt drift are rejected. No solver, install, Lean build or historical full suite was run.

Preserves 1337isnot1337's PR5016 builder/DAG/replay and PR4971/Cao Yifan predecessor attribution and source notices. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex/Astra assistance. Open next question: construct the genuine pair-consistent full-contact relaxation and obtain an exact dual or integer proof-tree certificate.
